It has been my favourite product for a long time now, suggested by a dermatologist. I have mixed skin, often with spots, etc... This cream nourishes my skin and purifies it at the same time. I often use it also on my neck and chest area.
I received a sample ages ago, and it was just amazing. I couldn’t find it around at the regular stores and found it here online. Love love love. So nice as a base or just by itself.

I've had hormonal acne since I was about 14 years old, and was recommended this product by a dermotologist who diagnosed me for oily/combination skin. I love the lightweight feel on my skin and it didn't irritate my face at all during the day. Even after seeing another dermotologist only a year ago, (who changed my previous night product) she felt there was no need for me to change my moisteriser. It still works great with my (upgraded) skincare and being used under an SPF helps it remain mattified.
